## Objects

Define `__init__` for construction; `self` is the instance. Methods are functions with `self` first.

## Dunder methods

Special methods power syntax: `__repr__`, `__eq__`, `__len__`, `__iter__`. Implement `__repr__` for debuggable objects.

## Properties

`@property` exposes computed attributes without breaking the `obj.attr` interface — no Java-style getters.
